description: Benign-looking URL with a long opaque query value. Use it to check that a high-entropy-looking value is treated as one signal, not proof of maliciousness.
test_intent: Check whether the analyser avoids declaring a URL malicious solely because a query parameter looks random or has relatively high entropy.
safety_note: This uses the reserved example.com domain and is a static test string. The test does not establish the real-world reputation of any website.
